title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: This emergency project was implemented in response to fire that occurred in May 2024 in the built up area of Mabella community, Freetown, Sierra Leone. Concern provided cash to the affected communities to cover their basic food needs and re-constructed damaged water and sanitation facilties with adaptations for people with disabilties. The project also worked with Community Disaster Management Committees and influential community leaders to strenghten their capacity on fire prevention, preparedness and response as well as hygiene practices. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Contribute to immediate food and other essential commodities as well as reducing the risk of severe disease outbreak among fire affected persons.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME:
